title: the-inference-proxy-is-a-rules-stack
intention: inference_domain becomes the ruled rules stack: provider, model, and provider-model-combo tables (shareable git-JSON beside the code; machine facts in ~/.cairn/inference/) plus a nest of sieves — cairn.tools.base.nest, this component as its second carrier — that lets out the lowest-cost route for every inference request: Hex first, cloud failovers, loopback never routed by default; the sole_path mesh joins build_inspector's roster (ruling item 1: in the build inspection).
why: The lived symptom, 2026-08-08: Akien typed 'hello' into the librarian's chat and nothing came back — the turn died at a 120s timeout because the proxy had exactly one road, a hard-wired 127.0.0.1 literal, and this box's CPU takes ~100s per 7B generate while Hex sits on the LAN 8x faster on its SMALLEST model. host.py filed this edge itself 2026-07-26 ('when a second appears this reads from ~/.cairn/'); the second appeared. The routing rules are also the Hex payback meter's supply side: every call routed to Hex instead of cloud is a measured saving against its purchase price.
traces_to: Ruling 2026-08-08-inference-proxy-is-a-rules-stack (confirmed); Law 6 (one owner: the proxy alone reaches inference hosts, and the inspection makes the sole path a build-time red); Law 1 (the routing decision compiled as rules, not re-derived per call); Telos 1 (the meter in the door makes every route's cost a measured fact).

falsifier.proves_green: code-seam@v2's registered set: entry gate at the BUILDME forward crossing (cast ticket + intent_berth + sorted_berth + berthed chart chain claiming this ticket); build gate at the PROVEME forward crossing (build_inspector's nest over cairn/devices/inference_domain); emission gate at the WATCHME forward crossing (probe berthed at cairn/devices/inference_domain/probes/does_the_route_leave_loopback.py, importable, module-level PROBE with carry and enough, armed before the crossing); exit gate at the PROVED entry (verdict artifact answering the claiming validate berth's criteria by their instruments); proof gate: plain-python teeth beside the code under the tester (netns seal), the standing test_host.py + test_inference_domain.py suites green through the change.
falsifier.proves_red: RED on any of: a generate miss lands with provenance.host = 127.0.0.1 while hex.local answers /api/version; any module outside cairn/devices/inference_domain/ can dial an inference host while build_inspector's roster stays green (ruling item 1 unenforced); Hex unreachable does not fail over to the next-cheapest dialable provider (proven with a fake provider, never the unkeyed rungs); the stacks exist but route() reads a literal anyway (rules decorative); the boat stands short of PROVED when this ticket claims done.
falsifier.horizon: Re-read at: the first cloud key landing in ~/.cairn (the failover rungs go live — do they dial?); the first measured divergence between authored costs and metered reality (assumption 2's expiry — the stack should start learning its numbers); the tenure loop reaching route learning; and the gradation watch's clear (this build makes inference_domain the second carrier of cairn.tools.base.nest).
